eps(v) from room-light scans (light 13:59, light 17:24); b(v) from the 2026-11-10 dark scans (dark 13:20, dark 16:36). R8486 at ~1000 V (operator; HV not in the files).
A ratio of 2 means the fixed level needs twice the counting time of the best level for the same 10 % precision on N. All levels shown are below 10 mV: pickup-sensitive.
